product_metadata.title: Household Essentials ML-6634 Cattail and Paper Waste Basket, Cream, Tan
features: Bedroom and bathroom waste bin for dry trash
Hand-woven wicker: light gray and cream water hyacinth
Dimensions: 10.23 inch diameter and 9.84 inches taller
description: Dress up the bath and bedroom trash with this cream-colored flexible wicker waste basket by Household Essentials. Flexible sides for easy use and comfortable emptying-fitness small sized trash bags and grocery bags. Neutral color fits into most home decors. This wicker trash can is made of cattail water hyacinth. It is best for use with dry trash. It may also be used as a decorative planter (not water tight; separate liner required).
